versions.changelog:
Initial release of clawsync-skill for OpenClaw setup backup and migration.

- Provides one-click backup and restore for OpenClaw configurations (skills, memory, settings, credentials, history, workspace).
- Supports full or quick backups, selective restore, encryption (password/GPG), and multiple storage backends (local, cloud, git).
- Command-line usage for backup, restore, list, export, and more.
- Enables device migration, disaster recovery, and easy sharing of setup between machines or users.
- Includes examples for typical backup/restore scenarios and integration with automation tools.
